Audit item: squint-c7ea926-vp8x-flag-clear-safe

Claim raised by an audit worker: Clearing the VP8X flags at `out[20]` in `strip_webp` (`core/src/webp.rs`) is safe and correct. Per the WebP container spec `VP8X` must be the first chunk, so the RIFF header is bytes 0..12, the `VP8X` chunk header is bytes 12..20, and the first payload byte holding the feature flags is exactly `out[20]`. The `out.len() > 20` guard prevents out-of-bounds indexing if `VP8X` has a zero-length payload or is cut short, and `&out[12..16] == b"VP8X"` ensures the flags are only modified when `VP8X` is in the first-chunk position.

Audit item: cookie-tab-cb74f3a-open-amount-override

Claim raised by an audit worker: Open-amount URL link param overwrite allows spoofing/underpayment. When a merchant chooses "Whatever the payer chooses, for a tip jar" in `Create.tsx`, the amount is ignored, but a crafted payload with `a` (or `u`) set alongside an open tip-jar request keeps `a` through `normalizeRequest`, and `Pay.tsx` checks `if (request.amount)` before `isOpenAmount(request)`. When a merchant chooses "Whatever the payer chooses, for a tip jar" in `Create.tsx`, the amount is ignored, but a crafted payload with `a` (or `u`) set alongside an open tip-jar request keeps `a` through `normalizeRequest`, and `Pay.tsx` checks `if (request.amount)` before `isOpenAmount(request)`. A link with `a: "0.000001"` therefore tricks a payer viewing an open tip jar into paying 0.000001 COOK instead of their intended tip: the UI's input expectation and the signed amount disagree.

Audit item: cookie-tab-cb74f3a-fragment-stale-pay
